notes: Frame this as the state’s hardest physical constraint, not a generic risk. Connect water to yield stability, crop choice, and income volatility, then signal that the next slides localize the problem by district and system. Expect the question: why is water now more decisive than markets or technology?
title: Water availability has become the binding constraint on Gujarat’s next phase of agricultural growth
subtitle: This section moves from crop leadership to the resource ceiling underneath it, showing why district-level water stress now matters more than additional acreage or crop-mix gains for farmer income growth.
